versos.hebraico: הִנֵּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה בּוֹקֵ֥ק הָאָ֖רֶץ וּבֽוֹלְקָ֑הּ וְעִוָּ֣ה פָנֶ֔יהָ וְהֵפִ֖יץ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃

controles.web: Behold, Yahweh makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
controles.kjv: Behold, the Lord maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.
controles.livre: Eis que o SENHOR esvazia a terra, e a assola; e transtorna sua superfície, e espalha seus moradores.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָ֤ה כָעָם֙ כַּכֹּהֵ֔ן כַּעֶ֨בֶד֙ כַּֽאדֹנָ֔יו כַּשִּׁפְחָ֖ה כַּגְּבִרְתָּ֑הּ כַּקּוֹנֶה֙ כַּמּוֹכֵ֔ר כַּמַּלְוֶה֙ כַּלֹּוֶ֔ה כַּנֹּשֶׁ֕ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר נֹשֶׁ֥א בֽוֹ׃

controles.web: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
controles.kjv: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.
controles.livre: E isso acontecerá, tanto ao povo, como ao sacerdote; tanto ao servo, como a seu senhor; tanto à serva, como a sua senhora; tanto ao comprador, como ao vendedor; tanto a quem empresta, como ao que toma emprestado; tanto ao credor, como ao devedor.

versos.hebraico: הִבּ֧וֹק׀ תִּבּ֛וֹק הָאָ֖רֶץ וְהִבּ֣וֹז׀ תִּבּ֑וֹז כִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה דִּבֶּ֖ר אֶת־הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for Yahweh has spoken this word.
controles.kjv: The land shall be utterly emptied, and utterly spoiled: for the Lord hath spoken this word.
controles.livre: A terra será esvaziada por completo, e será saqueada por completo; pois o SENHOR pronunciou esta palavra.

versos.hebraico: אָבְלָ֤ה נָֽבְלָה֙ הָאָ֔רֶץ אֻמְלְלָ֥ה נָבְלָ֖ה תֵּבֵ֑ל אֻמְלָ֖לוּ מְר֥וֹם עַם־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
controles.kjv: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the haughty people of the earth do languish.
controles.livre: A terra chora e se murcha; o mundo enfraquece e se murcha; estão enfraquecidos os mais elevados do povo da terra;

versos.hebraico: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ חָנְפָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת יֹשְׁבֶ֑יהָ כִּֽי־עָבְר֤וּ תוֹרֹת֙ חָ֣לְפוּ חֹ֔ק הֵפֵ֖רוּ בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
controles.kjv: The earth also is defiled under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, changed the ordinance, broken the everlasting covenant.
controles.livre: Pois a terra está contaminada por causa de seus moradores; pois transgridem as leis, mudam os estatutos, e anulam o pacto eterno.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֗ן אָלָה֙ אָ֣כְלָה אֶ֔רֶץ וַֽיֶּאְשְׁמ֖וּ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי בָ֑הּ עַל־כֵּ֗ן חָרוּ֙ יֹ֣שְׁבֵי אֶ֔רֶץ וְנִשְׁאַ֥ר אֱנ֖וֹשׁ מִזְעָֽר׃

controles.web: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
controles.kjv: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are desolate: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.
controles.livre: Pois isso, a maldição consome a terra; e os que nela habitam pagam por sua culpa; por isso serão queimados os moradores da terra, e poucos homens restarão.

versos.hebraico: אָבַ֥ל תִּיר֖וֹשׁ אֻמְלְלָה־גָ֑פֶן נֶאֶנְח֖וּ כָּל־שִׂמְחֵי־לֵֽב׃

controles.web: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
controles.kjv: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merryhearted do sigh.
controles.livre: O suco de uva chora, a vinha se enfraquece; todos os alegres de coração agora suspiram.

versos.hebraico: שָׁבַת֙ מְשׂ֣וֹשׂ תֻּפִּ֔ים חָדַ֖ל שְׁא֣וֹן עַלִּיזִ֑ים שָׁבַ֖ת מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ כִּנּֽוֹר׃

controles.web: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
controles.kjv: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.
controles.livre: A alegria dos tamborins parou, acabou o ruído dos que saltavam de prazer; a alegria da harpa parou.

versos.hebraico: בַּשִּׁ֖יר לֹ֣א יִשְׁתּוּ־יָ֑יִן יֵמַ֥ר שֵׁכָ֖ר לְשֹׁתָֽיו׃

controles.web: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
controles.kjv: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.
controles.livre: Não beberão vinho com canções; a bebida alcoólica será amarga aos que a beberem.

versos.hebraico: נִשְׁבְּרָ֖ה קִרְיַת־תֹּ֑הוּ סֻגַּ֥ר כָּל־בַּ֖יִת מִבּֽוֹא׃

controles.web: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
controles.kjv: The city of confusion is broken down: every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
controles.livre: A cidade da confusão está quebrada; todas as casas estão fechadas; ninguém pode entrar.

versos.hebraico: צְוָחָ֥ה עַל־הַיַּ֖יִן בַּֽחוּצ֑וֹת עָֽרְבָה֙ כָּל־שִׂמְחָ֔ה גָּלָ֖ה מְשׂ֥וֹשׂ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
controles.kjv: There is a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.
controles.livre: Um clamor de lamento por causa do vinho se ouve nas ruas; toda a alegria se escureceu; o prazer da terra sumiu.

versos.hebraico: נִשְׁאַ֥ר בָּעִ֖יר שַׁמָּ֑ה וּשְׁאִיָּ֖ה יֻכַּת־שָֽׁעַר׃

controles.web: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
controles.kjv: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.
controles.livre: Só restou assolação na cidade; o portão foi feito em ruínas.

versos.hebraico: כִּ֣י כֹ֥ה יִהְיֶ֛ה בְּקֶ֥רֶב הָאָ֖רֶץ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָֽעַמִּ֑ים כְּנֹ֣קֶף זַ֔יִת כְּעוֹלֵלֹ֖ת אִם־כָּלָ֥ה בָצִֽיר׃

controles.web: For it will be so in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
controles.kjv: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, there shall be as the shaking of an olive tree, and as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.
controles.livre: Porque assim será por entre a terra, e no meio destes povos; como quando se sacode a oliveira, e como as uvas que sobram depois de terminada a vindima.

versos.hebraico: הֵ֛מָּה יִשְׂא֥וּ קוֹלָ֖ם יָרֹ֑נּוּ בִּגְא֣וֹן יְהוָ֔ה צָהֲל֖וּ מִיָּֽם׃

controles.web: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of Yahweh. They cry aloud from the sea.
controles.kjv: They shall lift up their voice, they shall sing for the majesty of the Lord, they shall cry aloud from the sea.
controles.livre: Eles levantarão sua voz, e cantarão com alegria; por causa da glória do SENHOR, gritarão de alegria desde o mar.

versos.hebraico: עַל־כֵּ֥ן בָּאֻרִ֖ים כַּבְּד֣וּ יְהוָ֑ה בְּאִיֵּ֣י הַיָּ֔ם שֵׁ֥ם יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: Therefore glorify Yahweh in the east, even the name of Yahweh, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
controles.kjv: Wherefore glorify ye the Lord in the fires, even the name of the Lord God of Israel in the isles of the sea.
controles.livre: Por isso glorificai ao SENHOR no oriente;  e no litoral ao nome do SENHOR, o Deus de Israel.

versos.hebraico: מִכְּנַ֨ף הָאָ֜רֶץ זְמִרֹ֤ת שָׁמַ֨עְנוּ֙ צְבִ֣י לַצַּדִּ֔יק וָאֹמַ֛ר רָזִי־לִ֥י רָֽזִי־לִ֖י א֣וֹי לִ֑י בֹּגְדִ֣ים בָּגָ֔דוּ וּבֶ֥גֶד בּוֹגְדִ֖ים בָּגָֽדוּ׃

controles.web: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous! But I said, “I pine away! I pine away! woe is me!” The treacherous have dealt treacherously. Yes, the treacherous have dealt very treacherously.
controles.kjv: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, even glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.
controles.livre: Dos confins da terra ouvimos canções para a glória do Justo; mas eu digo: Fraqueza minha, fraqueza minha; ai de mim! Os enganadores enganam, e com enganação os enganadores agem enganosamente.

versos.hebraico: פַּ֥חַד וָפַ֖חַת וָפָ֑ח עָלֶ֖יךָ יוֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: Fear, the pit, and the snare, are on you who inhabitant the earth.
controles.kjv: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.
controles.livre: Temor, cova e laço vem sobre ti, ó morador da terra.

versos.hebraico: וְֽ֠הָיָה הַנָּ֞ס מִקּ֤וֹל הַפַּ֨חַד֙ יִפֹּ֣ל אֶל־הַפַּ֔חַת וְהָֽעוֹלֶה֙ מִתּ֣וֹךְ הַפַּ֔חַת יִלָּכֵ֖ד בַּפָּ֑ח כִּֽי־אֲרֻבּ֤וֹת מִמָּרוֹם֙ נִפְתָּ֔חוּ וַֽיִּרְעֲשׁ֖וּ מ֥וֹסְדֵי אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the midst of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.
controles.livre: E será que, aquele que fugir do som de temor cairá na cova; e aquele que subir da cova, o laço o prenderá; pois as janelas do alto se abrem; e os fundamentos da terra tremerão.

versos.hebraico: רֹ֥עָה הִֽתְרֹעֲעָ֖ה הָאָ֑רֶץ פּ֤וֹר הִֽתְפּוֹרְרָה֙ אֶ֔רֶץ מ֥וֹט הִֽתְמוֹטְטָ֖ה אָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
controles.kjv: The earth is utterly broken down, the earth is clean dissolved, the earth is moved exceedingly.
controles.livre: A terra será quebrada por completo; a terra será totalmente partida, e será muito abalada.

versos.hebraico: נ֣וֹעַ תָּנ֤וּעַ אֶ֨רֶץ֙ כַּשִּׁכּ֔וֹר וְהִֽתְנוֹדְדָ֖ה כַּמְּלוּנָ֑ה וְכָבַ֤ד עָלֶ֨יהָ֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔הּ וְנָפְלָ֖ה וְלֹא־תֹסִ֥יף קֽוּם׃ס

controles.web: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
controles.kjv: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.
controles.livre: A terra balançará como um bêbado; e será abalada como uma choupana; e sua transgressão pesará sobre ela; cairá, e nunca mais se levantará.

versos.hebraico: וְהָיָה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא יִפְקֹ֧ד יְהוָ֛ה עַל־צְבָ֥א הַמָּר֖וֹם בַּמָּר֑וֹם וְעַל־מַלְכֵ֥י הָאֲדָמָ֖ה עַל־הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

controles.web: It shall happen in that day that Yahweh will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
controles.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.
controles.livre: E será que naquele dia o SENHOR visitará para punir aos exércitos do alto na altura, e aos reis da terra sobre a terra.

versos.hebraico: וְאֻסְּפ֨וּ אֲסֵפָ֤ה אַסִּיר֙ עַל־בּ֔וֹר וְסֻגְּר֖וּ עַל־מַסְגֵּ֑ר וּמֵרֹ֥ב יָמִ֖ים יִפָּקֵֽדוּ׃

controles.web: They shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.
controles.kjv: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.
controles.livre: E juntamente serão amontoados como presos numa masmorra; e serão encarcerados num cárcere; e muitos dias depois serão visitados.

versos.hebraico: וְחָֽפְרָה֙ הַלְּבָנָ֔ה וּבוֹשָׁ֖ה הַֽחַמָּ֑ה כִּֽי־מָלַ֞ךְ יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֗וֹת בְּהַ֤ר צִיּוֹן֙ וּבִיר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם וְנֶ֥גֶד זְקֵנָ֖יו כָּבֽוֹד׃פ

controles.web: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Yahweh of Armies will reign on Mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders will be glory.
controles.kjv: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the Lord of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.
controles.livre: E a lua será envergonhada, e o sol humilhado, quando o SENHOR dos exércitos reinar no monte de Sião, e em Jerusalém; e então perante seus anciãos haverá glória.
